name: Glidy Addons for Elementor
author: Glidy Addons

sections.description:
Glidy Addons for Elementor enhances your Elementor workflow by providing a growing library of creative widgets, smooth animations, and advanced design tools — all optimized for performance and ease of use.

Whether you’re building landing pages, portfolios, business websites, or custom layouts, Glidy Addons gives you the flexibility to design faster and smarter without writing any code.

Designed with performance, responsiveness, and modern UI in mind, Glidy Addons works seamlessly with any Elementor-compatible WordPress theme.

🚀 Key Features

  • 32+ Creative Elementor Widgets
  • Theme Builder Support
    • Header Builder
    • Footer Builder
    • Archive Pages Builder
    • Single Page Builder
  • Smooth Animations & Interactive Elements
  • Custom CSS Support
  • Fully Responsive Controls
  • Lightweight & Performance Optimized
  • Cross-Browser Compatibility
  • 100% Elementor Compatible
  • No Coding Required
  • Beginner-Friendly & Easy to Use
  • Regular Updates & Improvements

🎯 Who Is It For?

Glidy Addons for Elementor is perfect for:
– Web designers
– Developers
– Agencies
– Freelancers
– Elementor users who want modern, animated, and flexible designs
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/glidy-addons-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor Editor and start using Glidy Addons widgets.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor to use this plugin?

Yes. Glidy Addons for Elementor is an addon for Elementor and requires Elementor Page Builder to be installed and activated.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. Glidy Addons works with any WordPress theme that is compatible with Elementor.

Is the plugin lightweight?

Absolutely. Performance is a top priority, and all widgets are optimized to load fast and smoothly.
